t: A small wheeled robot kit for learning how real robots map and drive.
steps: Buy the Burger or Waffle Pi kit from the ROBOTIS US store or a robot shop.
Set aside one to four hours and build the kit with the e-Manual assembly guide.
Install Ubuntu and ROS 2 on a laptop to act as the remote computer.
Write the TurtleBot3 image to a microSD card and put it in the Raspberry Pi.
Connect the robot and laptop to the same Wi-Fi network.
Run the keyboard driving example to move the robot around.
Try the SLAM tutorial to make your first map of the room.
Practice new ideas in the Gazebo simulator before trying them on the real robot.
meta: Open Board. From $784. A few stores.
